FIELDS.NAME: Leather Haven
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: At Leather Haven, we specialize in providing high-quality leather goods, including handbags, wallets, belts, and luggage. Our operations encompass both a brick-and-mortar retail store and a robust online sales platform, allowing us to reach a wider customer base. We focus on sourcing premium materials and ensuring our products meet stringent quality standards. Our store is equipped with modern security measures such as surveillance cameras and alarm systems to protect our inventory and enhance customer safety. We also implement comprehensive loss prevention strategies, including employee training programs to ensure our staff is well-equipped to manage risks effectively. With a commitment to customer satisfaction, we offer personalized service and occasional repair services for our products, all while adhering to relevant consumer protection and product safety regulations.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Loss dates: 01/15/2023; Cause: Water damage from a burst pipe; Amount: $3,000; Status: Resolved.  Loss dates: 05/10/2023; Cause: Theft of merchandise during a break-in; Amount: $2,000; Status: Under investigation.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Mon-Fri 10:00 AM - 7:00 PM, Sat 10:00 AM - 6:00 PM, Sun Closed
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Fire-rated safe, Class B, UL listed.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Central station alarm monitoring, security personnel during peak hours, and routine security audits.

FIELDS.G3: Are sub-contractors allowed to work: No – Subcontractors are not allowed to work without providing a certificate of insurance. The certificates are typically checked by the business manager or a designated staff member to ensure compliance.

The business focuses on retail operations without any involvement in such activities.

FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – Leather Haven does not lease employees to or from other employers as it maintains its own staff specifically for its retail operations.
FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: Yes – Leather Haven carries Workers' Compensation insurance to comply with legal requirements and protect its employees. This coverage ensures that employees are supported in the event of work-related injuries or illnesses.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: Yes – Leather Haven also owns and operates Leather Haven Repair & Accessories, LLC, which provides additional services related to leather goods.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – Leather Haven does not have any other insurance policies with this company at this time. We maintain our primary policy and ensure all necessary coverage is in place for our operations.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – Leather Haven is not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products. Our operations focus solely on retailing high-quality leather goods without engaging in any manufacturing processes.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – Leather Haven does not rent or loan equipment to others as our operations are focused solely on retailing leather goods and providing related services.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – Leather Haven has not experienced any foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien in the past five years, maintaining a stable financial history.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – Leather Haven does not have any exposure to flammables, explosives, or chemicals, as our operations are strictly focused on the retail and service of leather goods without involvement in hazardous materials.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – Leather Haven does not have any catastrophe exposure as it operates solely within retailing leather goods and does not engage in activities associated with significant risk. The business focuses on maintaining safe operations and adequate preparedness for potential incidents.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – Leather Haven has not had any past losses or claims related to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring. The business maintains a strong commitment to ethical practices and employee training.
